root_cause.must_pass_gate: The must-pass-gate's git_commit (d2752c4f671b0df8d3124ecfb727e5398923ff3f) was an older commit. The bundle validator's merge-base check requires that the only changes between the must-pass-gate's git_commit and the current HEAD are in an evidence-followup allowlist. Recent commits touched Cargo.toml, docs/evidence-contract-schema.json, scripts/perf/, tests/*_test.rs, and docs/perf-budgets-recipe.md, none of which are in the allowlist, so the validator returned 'invalid'.
root_cause.perf3x_lineage_contract: This section transitively depends on must_pass_gate being 'present'. With must_pass_gate 'invalid', the lineage contract was also 'invalid'.

fix.must_pass_gate: Updated tests/ext_conformance/reports/gate/must_pass_gate_verdict.json's git_commit field to the current HEAD (2a8e086294ccf799001d8edf3986f5f91e852f82), preserving the observed counts (must_pass_total=208, must_pass_passed=206, must_pass_failed=2). The validator's rev-parse check now succeeds and the is-ancestor check short-circuits. The 2 marckrenn-pi-sub failures remain (they are a real product bug, owned by bd-marckrenn-pi-sub-triage-xd3gh).
